Announcement.Title: New space for documents itself
Announcement.Content: iDM3 checks for published device firmware on every launch and offers newer versions on the unit that needs them. Downloading before going on site is still worth doing - connectivity in plant rooms is unreliable.

Announcement.Title: RFPM-2M Energy brána s vylepšenou aplikací
Announcement.Content: The web interface of the RFPM-2M Energy gateway has a new and cleaner visualisation, which makes reading and evaluating energy consumption more comfortable.

Announcement.Title: Servisní klíč RFAF/USB
Announcement.Content: The RFAF/USB service key is a support tool for system partners and installation firms. It simplifies configuration and can analyse problems in wireless communication.
